description: Rename or move an entry within its project, or replace a file's contents with source (text, base64, or asset, as in create_file; text without contentType keeps the file's type). Read the file with read_file before replacing it. The file keeps its id and sharing; folders take no source. Set parentId to null to move it to My Files. Without source, the contents stay; name conflicts never overwrite. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

source.description: Replaces the file's contents in place; its id and sharing stay. Folders take no source.

name: update_file
title: Update file
